**Social Media Manager**
Currently I handle Edgeware's Twitter and Instagram.

- I can fully handle or assist you in running your social media account by bringing forth good content and presenting them in the most pleasant manner.
- Present monthly report on the performance of your social media.
- Research and discuss the best strategy that fits your organization or brand.
- Help set up social media accounts in different platforms. 


**Event and Competition manager/host**

- I can host competitions for your community. I have done the same for Edgeware with quizzes and meme competitions which have done pretty well.
- I can also set up events online that can bring forth great engagement for your community.


**Video Editing**

- I can edit videos for Youtube or other social media accounts.
